speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Hay is dear. What is left of last year's. Father says we shall be buying before the new comes, and he says it as if the hay had been rude to him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You were sent at four. You begin with the hay.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: The bay is tired. I'll take him. Bridge Street is not a speech. Joan has the table in hand. Edmund has asked twice if you brought a death worth hearing. I am telling you out here, because I will not tell you again at the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take him. The rest of the news can walk.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: The river is up. You can see that without me. Mother is in the house. Anne is in the house. I was told to watch the bridge, and I have, and you are what came.
